title: Compiled Choice Step
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program, $l_0$ an initial program state, $D$ a decider machine, and $q_0$ an assignment of initial decider states. Suppose $A(l)$ is the choice instruction with targets $l_1$ and $l_0'$. For any input word $x$, choice bit $b$, register valuation $v$, and output word, one step of the compiled machine from the configuration formed by adjoining blank auxiliary tapes to the arithmetic configuration at $l$ with valuation $v$ and output word equals the similarly formed configuration at $l_1$ if $b$ is true and at $l_0'$ if $b$ is false, with the valuation and output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $A(l)$ is the choice instruction with targets $l_1,l_0'$
